hero.title: Claude Code vs. Claude Cowork
hero.subtitle: Both delegate work to Claude. Here is how they differ.
item-1.subtitle: Developer Tools
item-1.title: Claude Code
item-1.body: An agentic coding assistant that works directly in your codebase, across terminal, IDE, web, and mobile.
item-1.pros: Opens pull requests end to end
IDE extensions for VS Code and JetBrains
item-1.cons: Built for developers, not general office work
Best value requires an existing codebase
item-2.subtitle: Productivity
item-2.title: Claude Cowork
item-2.body: An agentic productivity tool for non-coding professionals that completes multi-step work directly in your files and tools.
item-2.pros: Built for marketing, sales, legal, finance
Runs in the background, even laptop closed
Splits large projects into parallel sub-tasks
Shows every step, file, and decision
item-2.cons: Not built for writing or editing source code
Newer product with a smaller plugin ecosystem
verdict.title: Pick based on who's doing the work
verdict.body: Choose Claude Code if your team ships software; choose Claude Cowork if your team's work lives in documents, spreadsheets, and cross-functional projects.
cta.title: Still deciding?
cta.subtitle: Try both and see which fits your workflow.
